verdict.rationale: Gusto documents its own banking product: a guided flow to form a company, get an EIN and open a business bank account, pitched as a "day-one business bank account" with no lengthy application, no branch visit and no minimum balance. That supports fast banking onboarding, and the bank account itself is provided by Increase Bank. The capability is explicitly in early beta and rolling out only gradually, and the speed claim is vendor-only (the CPA Practice Advisor item merely repeats the press release). Missing for 10: general availability beyond early beta, independent or hands-on corroboration of actual onboarding time, and documentation of what "fully onboarded" covers (verification and approval timelines, migrating from an existing bank).
